notes.text:
This update for pgvector fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-103484: database users with the ability to create an IVFFlat index can write data out-of-bounds, which can
  lead to arbitrary code execution (bsc#1284129).

Changes for pgvector:

- Updated to version 0.8.7
